name: CALVIN Robot Learning Benchmark
description: A multi-task robot learning benchmark in the CALVIN simulator for learning long-horizon manipulation skills from visual input and language/goal conditioning. It evaluates an agent's ability to generalize across sequences of household manipulation tasks.
evaluation_method: success_rate over task sequences, average task success, rollout completion rate
notes: Designed for continual and compositional robot learning. Performance is often reported on fixed task sequences and generalization splits rather than a single scalar only.
